title: University of Auckland Vaka Moana Scholarship
description: The University of Auckland Vaka Moana Scholarship supports Indigenous Pacific students enrolling in their first year of undergraduate study at the University of Auckland. It is offered annually and is worth up to $24,000, comprising one year of catered accommodation in a University of Auckland Hall of Residence plus a laptop. Applications for the 2027 round opened on 20 May 2026 and closed at midday on 12 August 2026.

title: Vice-Chancellor's International Excellence Scholarship
description: The Vice-Chancellor's International Excellence Scholarship was established in 2015 to promote educational opportunities, foster internationalisation and support talented international applicants enrolling for the first time as new students into undergraduate or postgraduate programmes at the University of Waikato. It is worth up to NZD$15,000 towards tuition fees, is open to all areas of study, and is reviewed monthly rather than against a single annual closing date.

title: Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship for International Students
official_source: University of Otago | Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka
description: The University of Otago's Vice-Chancellor's Scholarship for International Students was established in 2020 to celebrate and welcome international students to the University of Otago | Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka as valued members of its community, and is awarded to support students to pursue their academic goals. It is an Entrance Scholarship worth NZD$10,000 with a one-year tenure, payable only as a credit towards tuition fees. title: University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship
official_source: University of Otago | Ōtākou Whakaihu Waka
description: The University of Otago International Master's Research Scholarship provides funding to support international Master's students studying at the University of Otago. It pays a stipend of NZ$18,204 per annum plus a tuition fee waiver for one year capped at NZ$35,000 for Master's study, excluding the student services fee and insurance. Four awards are offered, normally one per Academic Division. Applicants must be international students undertaking a thesis-based Master's as their first Master's qualification, and selection is based predominantly on academic merit and research potential.

title: University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship
degree: Doctoral (PhD and professional doctorates: DClinDent, DMA, DBA, EDd)
duration: PhD: tuition fee waiver for 36 months; professional doctorates: waiver for up to 36 months
description: The University of Otago Doctoral Scholarship is the University's main doctoral award, funding PhD and professional doctorate (DClinDent, DMA, DBA, EDd) candidates at the University of Otago in Dunedin, New Zealand. It pays a NZ$34,128 per annum stipend plus a tuition fee waiver for 36 months at the domestic rate, and excludes student services fee and insurance. Up to 153 awards are offered annually to both domestic and international applicants who are seeking their first doctoral qualification. title: Konstanty Kalinowski Scholarship
degree: Bachelor, Master, Engineer, Long-cycle Master, Doctoral, Postgraduate
funding: Tuition + Monthly stipend + Accommodation + Health insurance
program_type: Government scholarship programme for Belarusian students unable to continue their education in Belarus
duration: 1 semester to entire study programme (1–3 years depending on degree)
description: The Konstanty Kalinowski Scholarship Programme is a Polish Government scholarship programme addressed in particular to socially and politically active citizens of Belarus who cannot continue their education in their own country because of their political activity. It offers scholarships for bachelor's, master's and doctoral studies as well as research internships and postgraduate studies in all fields of study, and runs two strands: Programme KK I for studies at institutions across Poland and Programme KK II for one-year research stays in Warsaw.

title: Ulam NAWA Programme
degree: Doctoral (employs researchers holding at least a doctoral degree)
official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
program_type: Institutional research programme funding employment of foreign scientists in Poland
duration: 6 to 24 months of full-time employment at the Polish host institution; projects must start between 1 February and 1 December 2027
description: The Ulam NAWA Programme is an institutional programme of the Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange that lets Polish higher education and research institutions employ outstanding scientists from abroad for 6 to 24 months, with projects starting between 1 February and 1 December 2027. The funding covers remuneration of the invited Principal Investigator up to PLN 17,000 per month including employer costs and an allowance of up to PLN 1,200 per month for the Inviting Person, with a maximum of PLN 436,800 per project.
